resolutions.corridor_desc: El Minya Governorate — a 12-inch, 20 km connector from the El-Tibeen/Assiut oil-products trunk east of the Nile to a fuel depot at El Minya.
resolutions.researcher_notes: NOT DRAWN — one end only, and the other end may only be inferred from GEM's own geometry, which rule 1 forbids citing. IDENTITY IS NOW WELL SOURCED: this is a PPC (Petroleum Pipelines Company, EGPC subsidiary) 12-inch/20 km doubling of the connector feeding the Cooperation Petroleum (التعاون للبترول) depot at El Minya, announced Dec 2021 alongside two sibling projects that map onto GEM's own P7316 (140 km Minya-Assiut doubling) and P7325 (75 km Tebbin/Assiut renewal); its 88M EGP cost matches GEM's Cost column exactly. An independently dated second source (dostor.org, 29 Aug 2023, a PPC board meeting) restates the same 12-inch / 20 km / El-Tibeen-Assiut / El Minya spec, supporting the current 'construction' status ~20 months on. The El Minya depot END is pinned at medium via OSM (an 11-tank farm inside industrial polygon way/100024721, centroid 30.7594/28.0747, ~2 km SSW of El Minya city on the Cairo-Aswan railway); OSM carries no name tag, so the identification as specifically the Cooperation depot is inferred. The START — the tie-in point on the trunk — is NOT independently sourced: no Arabic or English source names a town, station or valve site there, and the only candidate point comes from GEM's own P7325/P7334 route vertices. Operator finding for Update: PPC, not ASORC (ASORC's refinery is the trunk's downstream customer).
